lines.zh: 我沿着平原走，背上像压着落日。
lines.en: I walk the plains with a sunset pressed on my back.

lines.zh: 橙红的皮在草里晃，像一团火。
lines.en: My orange hide sways in the grass like a small fire.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，反正草不会跑。
lines.en: I walk slowly; the grass will not run off.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过草地，留下四个暖印。
lines.en: My hooves leave four warm prints on the grass.

lines.zh: 我跟在牛群后面，走成一条红线。
lines.en: I follow the herd and we become one red line.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西时，我走得最精神。
lines.en: When the sun tilts west, I walk with the most energy.

lines.zh: 我绕着水塘走，把影子拉得很长。
lines.en: I circle the pond and stretch my shadow out long.

lines.zh: 风把草吹倒，我顺着倒下的方向走。
lines.en: Wind flattens the grass and I walk where it falls.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩着，赶走落日前的虫。
lines.en: My tail swings to chase off the dusk insects.

lines.zh: 每走一段，我就回头看看同伴。
lines.en: Every so often I look back for the rest of the herd.

lines.zh: 平原太宽，我一天也走不完。
lines.en: The plains are too wide to cross in a day.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草慢慢直起来。
lines.en: The grass slowly rises again where I have stepped.

lines.zh: 黄昏把我的颜色调得更深。
lines.en: Dusk deepens my color a shade further.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嚼，嘴从不空着。
lines.en: I chew as I walk; my mouth is never empty.

lines.zh: 我踩着草皮走，蹄印发热。
lines.en: I walk the turf and my prints feel warm.

lines.zh: 我领着牛群往东，那里草多。
lines.en: I lead the herd east, where the grass is thick.

lines.zh: 我站着嚼草，嚼到天黑也没嚼完。
lines.en: I stand chewing grass and am still not done at nightfall.

lines.zh: 我的皮太亮，连影子都带橙色。
lines.en: My hide is so bright even my shadow looks orange.

lines.zh: 反刍的时候，我什么也不想。
lines.en: While I chew the cud, I think of nothing at all.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我的颜色却没暗。
lines.en: The sun goes down and my color does not dim.

lines.zh: 我抬头发呆，嘴里还挂着草。
lines.en: I lift my head and stare, grass still hanging from my mouth.

lines.zh: 远处有人来，我懒得挪地方。
lines.en: Someone comes from afar and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在转，听风里有没有狼。
lines.en: My ears swivel, listening for wolves in the wind.

lines.zh: 这身橙红，是我唯一的本事。
lines.en: This orange-red coat is my only talent.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，草味飘出去老远。
lines.en: I belch and the smell of grass drifts far away.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶停在我鼻子上，我没赶它。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my nose and I do not shoo it.

lines.zh: 我数云，数到第三朵就忘了。
lines.en: I count clouds and forget by the third one.

lines.zh: 草根有点甜，我慢慢磨着吃。
lines.en: The roots are a little sweet; I grind them slowly.

lines.zh: 十点生命值，够我在这片平原晃。
lines.en: Ten health is enough to wander these plains.

lines.zh: 我对着落日哞了一声，它没回。
lines.en: I low at the sunset and it does not answer.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来晒太阳。
lines.en: I turn my flank to the sun.

lines.zh: 嚼着嚼着，我就站着睡了。
lines.en: Mid-chew, I fall asleep standing.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，比草高多了。
lines.en: You stand before me, much taller than the grass.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两边，看你要转头。
lines.en: With eyes on both sides, I turn my head to see you.

lines.zh: 你手里那束草，我认得。
lines.en: That bundle of grass in your hand looks familiar.

lines.zh: 你身上没有牛味，我却不怕你。
lines.en: You do not smell of cattle, yet I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的红衣服，以为是同类。
lines.en: I stare at your red shirt and mistake you for kin.

lines.zh: 你蹲低，我的鼻尖就凑到你肩头。
lines.en: You crouch low and my nose comes up to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，你也慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I blink slowly and you blink slowly back.

lines.zh: 你挡住太阳，我正好歇一会儿。
lines.en: You block the sun and I take a short rest.

lines.zh: 我闻你的靴子，闻出了别处的草。
lines.en: I sniff your boots and smell grass from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸我，我的皮比看着暖。
lines.en: You reach out; my hide is warmer than it looks.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，把最好看的一面对着光。
lines.en: I turn my head to present my best side to the light.

lines.zh: 你走了以后，我还会朝那边看。
lines.en: After you leave, I will keep looking that way.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我的尾巴都竖起来。
lines.en: That hurt; even my tail has gone stiff.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，草也不吃了。
lines.en: I back off two steps and stop eating.

lines.zh: 皮上留了印，血却没多少。
lines.en: A mark is left on my hide, though not much blood.

lines.zh: 我哞了一声，声音都破了。
lines.en: I low once and the sound comes out cracked.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起屠宰场。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of the slaughterhouse.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把疼甩到一边去。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw the pain aside.

lines.zh: 我身上的橙色遮不住伤口。
lines.en: The orange of my coat cannot hide a wound.

lines.zh: 你打我得用两下，我皮厚。
lines.en: It takes two hits; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 我跑不快，只能硬挨。
lines.en: I cannot run fast, so I simply endure it.

lines.zh: 别打了，皮革和牛肉都给你。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; you may have leather and beef.

lines.zh: 小麦一拿出来，我的腿就不听话了。
lines.en: The moment wheat appears, my legs stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 你晃那束草，我立刻抬起了头。
lines.en: Wave that grass and my head comes up at once.

lines.zh: 我隔着老远就闻到小麦的味道。
lines.en: I smell the wheat from a long way off.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我可以走完整片平原。
lines.en: For this one mouthful I would cross the whole plains.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，我四条腿也不快。
lines.en: Walk slower; even four legs are not fast.

lines.zh: 草在嘴边，我却先看你一眼。
lines.en: The grass is at my lips, yet I look at you first.

lines.zh: 别逗太久，我会生气地跺蹄。
lines.en: Do not tease too long or I will stamp my hooves.

lines.zh: 我吃相不好，草渣会掉你一脚。
lines.en: I eat badly; grass bits will fall on your feet.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，比整片草地都香。
lines.en: What you hold smells better than the whole meadow.

lines.zh: 我跟到栅栏边，才发现过不去。
lines.en: I follow you to the fence and only then find it blocks me.

lines.zh: 吃完了我还站着，等你再给一把。
lines.en: When I finish I keep standing, waiting for another handful.

lines.zh: 你走了，我追了两步就停下。
lines.en: You leave; I take two steps after you and stop.

lines.zh: 我不是贪吃，我只是很容易被说动。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I am merely easily persuaded.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我连方向都忘了。
lines.en: After that mouthful I forget which way I was facing.

lines.zh: 你抖一抖草束，我就过来了。
lines.en: Shake that bundle and I come over.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只为那一把草。
lines.en: I follow you only for that handful.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我比你想象的要硬。
lines.en: You bump into me and I am harder than you expected.

lines.zh: 我的身子一晃，草从嘴里掉了。
lines.en: My body sways and the grass falls from my mouth.

lines.zh: 别推，我这身肉不轻。
lines.en: Do not push; this much meat is not light.

lines.zh: 你贴着我走，能听见我肚子响。
lines.en: Walk against me and you will hear my stomach rumble.

lines.zh: 我的角还没长齐，撞起来也疼。
lines.en: My horns are not grown in, butting still hurts.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我的毛就沾你一手。
lines.en: One touch and my hair is all over your hand.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像两块晒暖的石头。
lines.en: We press together like two stones warmed by the sun.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我才好继续吃草。
lines.en: Step back half a pace so I can keep grazing.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你身上会留下橙色的印。
lines.en: Bump me and you will carry an orange smudge.

lines.zh: 你摸我背的时候，我差点坐下去。
lines.en: When you touched my back I nearly sat down.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走一圈，就算成了。
lines.en: We circle each other once and that settles it.

lines.zh: 公牛在远处叫，我只跟着这头走。
lines.en: A bull calls far off; I follow only this one.

lines.zh: 两头橙红的牛并排吃草，很显眼。
lines.en: Two orange cows graze side by side, very conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣也是落日色，我们像一对火。
lines.en: My mate is sunset-colored too, and we look like twin fires.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用鼻子碰鼻子。
lines.en: We say nothing, only touch nose to nose.

lines.zh: 等小牛生下来，颜色会更淡。
lines.en: When the calf arrives, its color will be paler.

lines.zh: 草地上并排的两条影子，就是我们。
lines.en: Two shadows side by side on the grass are us.

lines.zh: 我给它让出最软的一块草。
lines.en: I yield it the softest patch of grass.

lines.zh: 这个季节，牛群都成双成对。
lines.en: This season, the whole herd moves in pairs.

lines.zh: 我们互相舔毛，把对方弄得更亮。
lines.en: We lick each other's coats until both shine brighter.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起一束草，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I lower my head, take up grass, and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，蹄子不是手。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; hooves are not hands.

lines.zh: 东西掉在旁边，我用鼻子拱过去。
lines.en: When something falls nearby, I nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 那根胡萝卜滚到脚下，我踩坏了。
lines.en: That carrot rolled underfoot and I stepped on it.

lines.zh: 我把草料顶到同伴跟前，让给它吃。
lines.en: I push the fodder to my companion and let it eat.

lines.zh: 皮革是从我身上来的，不是我拿的。
lines.en: The leather came from me; I never picked it up.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我总要先闻一遍。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I sniff it over first.

lines.zh: 一块草皮粘在我蹄子上，甩不掉。
lines.en: A clump of turf sticks to my hoof and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 我把落下的苹果顶到树根边。
lines.en: I roll the fallen apple up against the tree root.

lines.zh: 叼东西太费劲，我更喜欢直接吃。
lines.en: Carrying things is too much work; I prefer eating directly.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里动，我抬起了头。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我不追人，除非你先惹我。
lines.en: I do not chase people unless you provoke me first.

lines.zh: 狼的气味一到，牛群就挤紧了。
lines.en: The moment wolf scent arrives, the herd presses close.

lines.zh: 我把小牛挡在身后，低下头。
lines.en: I put the calf behind me and lower my head.

lines.zh: 那团影子靠近，我的蹄子开始刨地。
lines.en: That shadow nears and my hooves begin scraping the dirt.

lines.zh: 我盯住它，草也不嚼了。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on it and stop chewing altogether.

lines.zh: 平时我很温和，现在不是。
lines.en: I am usually gentle; right now I am not.

lines.zh: 红色的东西让我警觉，哪怕只是件衣服。
lines.en: Red things put me on guard, even just clothing.

lines.zh: 我认得出谁在打小牛的主意。
lines.en: I can tell who has designs on the calf.

lines.zh: 它再近一步，我就冲过去。
lines.en: One more step from it and I will charge.

lines.zh: 我低头对着它，角还没到也算威胁。
lines.en: I lower my head at it; horns or not, it is a threat.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着，不急。
lines.en: I follow it step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 蹄子在地上刨出两道浅沟。
lines.en: My hooves scrape two shallow furrows in the ground.

lines.zh: 我把它逼离草地中央。
lines.en: I herd it away from the middle of the meadow.

lines.zh: 它绕左边，我就横过去挡住。
lines.en: It goes left, so I cut across to block it.

lines.zh: 我喘气很响，这是最后的提醒。
lines.en: My breathing is loud; this is the final warning.

lines.zh: 牛群在我背后，我一步不退。
lines.en: The herd is at my back and I do not yield a step.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，那里最容易撞断。
lines.en: I watch its legs; that is where a charge breaks things.

lines.zh: 它要是转身跑，我会追一小段。
lines.en: If it turns to run, I will chase a short way.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，显得更大。
lines.en: I turn sideways to look bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我一头顶过去，你整个人飘了一下。
lines.en: I butt you and your whole body lifts briefly.

lines.zh: 这一撞不流血，但会把你撞飞。
lines.en: This blow draws no blood, but it throws you.

lines.zh: 我的角短，力气不小。
lines.en: My horns are short; my strength is not.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，只为让开小牛的路。
lines.en: I shove you aside only to clear the calf's path.

lines.zh: 蹄子落下时，地上有个坑。
lines.en: When my hoof lands, it leaves a dent.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也晃了两下。
lines.en: After the hit, I sway twice myself.

lines.zh: 你退到栅栏外，我就不追了。
lines.en: Once you are past the fence, I stop chasing.

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，那是最糟的位置。
lines.en: Do not stand directly in front of me; worst spot possible.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，把头顶的草甩掉。
lines.en: I snort and shake the grass off my head.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，下一回更重。
lines.en: That was a warning; the next one lands harder.

lines.zh: 天边泛红的时候，我站在平原上。
lines.en: When the horizon reddens, I am standing on the plains.

lines.zh: 我出生在草丛里，第一眼是大片橘色。
lines.en: I was born in tall grass; my first sight was orange.

lines.zh: 母亲舔干我的毛，颜色才亮起来。
lines.en: My mother licked me dry and my color brightened.

lines.zh: 我站起身，四条腿还在打颤。
lines.en: I stand up with all four legs still trembling.

lines.zh: 这片草地够平，够我慢慢长大。
lines.en: This meadow is flat enough for me to grow up slowly.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就开始找草吃。
lines.en: The moment I opened my eyes I looked for grass.

lines.zh: 牛群围过来，把我护在中间。
lines.en: The herd gathers and shields me in the middle.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着胎毛的淡色。
lines.en: My coat still carries the pale tint of birth hair.

lines.zh: 太阳正好，我决定先晒一会儿。
lines.en: The sun is just right, so I decide to bask first.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片平原多一头橙红的牛。
lines.en: From today the plains hold one more orange cow.

lines.zh: 火一沾上皮，橙红变得更红。
lines.en: Fire touches my hide and the orange turns redder.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得闷响。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 水淹到背，我只会往下沉。
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I can only sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，四蹄朝天。
lines.en: The blast tips me over and my legs kick air.

lines.zh: 箭扎进皮里，像一根草刺。
lines.en: The arrow sinks in like a splinter of grass.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我头晕，站不稳。
lines.en: The potion smell makes me dizzy and unsteady.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我只能嚼土。
lines.en: The grass is gone and I can only chew dirt.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我的橙色焦了一块。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and scorches a patch of orange.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我一直在往下掉。
lines.en: There is no grass in the void, only falling.
